## Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
- Briefly describe the purpose and scope of this pull request.

### Related Issue
- Closes #[Issue Number] (e.g. Closes #1)

### Type of Change
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] Refactor / Architecture improvement
- [ ] CI/CD / DevOps / Docker / Jenkins configuration
- [ ] Documentation update

### Testing & Verification
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated
- [ ] Local build verified (`mvn clean verify`)
- [ ] Health check and API endpoints verified

### Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's code conventions and SOLID principles.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have added appropriate comments and JavaDoc annotations where necessary.
- [ ] My changes generate no new compiler warnings.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or API keys are committed.
